name: Oath of the Deep

attributes.description:
A blade tempered for those who stand against the deep.

Sweeping Edge: 12% chance on a successful normal weapon attack to strike one enemy beside your target for 50% physical attack damage, up to 30. Cooldown: 8 seconds.
Legendary weapon cooldowns are shared by your character. Extra damage is based on the original attack before critical bonuses and mitigation; armor, resistance and player damage rules still apply.
